resources.string: Type the code from the sign-in page of Claude or another agent
No agent is connected. When Claude asks to connect to Dayhand, its page shows a code: approve it here.
An agent connected here reads and changes your plan as itself; its changes show in history under its name. Disconnecting stops it at once. API keys for the terminal are not listed here.
Could not load the connections. Check the connection to the server.
The server refused this phone. Pair it again under Server.
It stops working at once. To use it again, connect it again from its app.
The page that asks for access shows a code like K7QF-M2XA. Only approve a code you see on your own screen right now.
No waiting request has this code. Check it, or start connecting again: a code is valid for 10 minutes.
Too many wrong codes. Try again in a few minutes.
Could not reach the server. Try again.
%1$s asks for access to your Dayhand plan
Registered itself (its name is not verified)
This request is several minutes old. Approve only a sign-in page you opened yourself just now; if someone sent you this code, refuse.
The answer goes to a program on the computer that opened the page (Claude Code). Approve only if you started it yourself just now.
Add, edit, complete and delete tasks; change settings
Choose at least one thing to allow, or refuse.
Approved. Go back to the sign-in page: it continues on its own.
Refused. The sign-in page tells the agent no.
This request has expired or was already decided.
